characters.prophet: DJ Gifted Prophet — a young Caucasian man with Ray-Ban nerdy glasses, a black baseball cap with white letters 'LL' on the front, wearing a light blue Lacoste polo and black pants with Nike Air Max shoes, dressed as a modern hip hop DJ. (No female vocalist on this track.)

concept: Derived purely from the lyrics. DJ Gifted Prophet is the 'day one' — from a basement tape-and-crate setup to the on-chain ledger. The 'block' = both a city block (graffiti wall / tag / flame) and the blockchain: his name gets 'inscribed in the block', 'little numbers by my name', 'scroll through the chains see the tag and the flame', 'who's that? in the blocks in my name'. Themes: basement->browsers, corners->coinbase, rug pulls shrugged off, 'don't cheat don't black don't change', staying on the chain as OG. West Coast / modern hip hop DJ palette, neon-decay + club basement + graffiti wall. SMALL % slow-mo (scenes 5 and 11). No on-screen text. Single performer only (no female vocalist this track).
